programme.title: Beauty And the Billionaire- Series
programme.desc: Mason’s product launch is failing, leading him to make life difficult for Jess. Stan wants to discuss Mason’s business missteps at a dinner with a few trusted friends. Jess is invited along and witnesses first-hand the drama Mason faces in his own family.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.desc: Elinor Dashwood is frustrated when her sister Marianne announces she will move in to her apartment. Marianne has little regard for the way Elinor does things, and the sisters butt heads. Lizzie Bennet begs for her friend, Emma Woodhouse, to try to keep her parents from getting a divorce, even though Emma is a divorce attorney. Lizzie meets Mr. Darcy, her latest--and most difficult--real estate client to please.

programme.title: The Importance Of Being Mike
programme.desc: Ali meets another Mike who likes to be a little too close for comfort.

programme.title: It's a Fixer Upper
programme.desc: When The Dovers find they’re in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne’s parent’s left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew’s Children’s Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.title: My One True Love
programme.desc: When 2 of the 3 things a fortune teller predicts come true, Ali wonders about the 3rd - finding true love with a man named John. Drawn to a fireman whose name isn't John, does she trust destiny or her heart?

programme.title: Beauty and The Billionaire
programme.desc: Addison gets roped into traveling overseas with her brother and his picky billionaire boss. But clashing with the billionaire is no vacation, until he starts to have a change of heart.

programme.title: Love on The Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

programme.title: Beauty And the Billionaire- Series
programme.desc: Jess learns the reality of the danger Mason faces. While her father searches for a new job, Jess is left struggling with rumors about being Mason’s so-called assistant. Mason prepares a product launch but the pressure is on from his father and competitors.

programme.title: Love’s Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?
